name: hitl-codex-plugin
description: Self-contained Codex plugin for the HITL AI-Driven Development platform. Installs Codex project instructions, lifecycle hooks, git hooks, convention checks, templates, and optional Graphify support.

interface.shortDescription: Install and follow the HITL Codex workflow
interface.longDescription: HITL Codex installs the HITL AI-Driven Development workflow for Codex: docs-first planning, human approval gates, scoped implementation, lifecycle hooks, git hooks, convention checks, traceability, and optional Graphify context retrieval.
